notes: isSafeUrl() calls net.isIP(u.hostname) at line 118. WHATWG URL.hostname keeps the brackets on IPv6 literals, so net.isIP('[::1]') returns 0 and the private-IP branches never run; the hostname branch then resolves '[::1]', dns.lookup throws, resolveAllIps() swallows it to [] and the guard returns ok:true. The HTTP client strips brackets and connects anyway. This is the first commit containing the guard (eba4abf, 2025-09-24); the same shape persists at HEAD 418e58aad2d0 plus a MCP_FETCH_DISABLE_SSRF_GUARD env kill-switch, so no patched state exists. Redirects are manually re-validated per hop (safeFollowFetch, line 175), so the site is not G6.
